intent: Move the contributor-research default and bounded identity clustering into the Giving model itself so incognito initialization and large multi-source searches remain child-legible and responsive.
notes: The title anchor intentionally matches the model line exactly; the validator should reject drift rather than guess.
The indexed windows preserve exact-name connectivity without materializing every pair and bound each record to at most 24 candidate comparisons.
Fine-grained locality/employer buckets run before exact-name fallback so scarce candidate budget is spent on higher-information neighbors.
Do not promote the SAMPLE fixture to evidentiary authority; it exercises the same real route with fictional content only.
